principles: Identity and parameter recipes are canonical; generated vertices are disposable.
Authored anatomy is a design claim, not an observation of a person.
Rendering, validation, and packaging do not create independent observation roots.
Keep state changes separate from read-only queries.
Retain Unknown, NotObserved, ObservedAbsent and NotApplicable as distinct states.
Source revisions remain addressable; generator changes create a new revision.

viewPolicy.name: r2-source-recipe-view@1
viewPolicy.selection: Keep the locked R2 reference and Motion-Lab kernel. Allow declared stature [0.94, 1.06] and seven bounded regional [-1, 1] parameters through the shared shape contract. Distinguish captured motion, published standards and authored shape/contact adaptations; reject unknown parameters and direct joint goals.
viewPolicy.conflictPolicy: Keep unresolved differences in uncertainty; do not average incompatible evidence.
